data.title: Accident questionnaire request from Beispiel Versicherung (car liability claim)
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG, handling a car liability claim from the accident on 28 April 2026, asks the recipient to fill in and return an accident questionnaire (Fragebogen zum Unfallhergang) within 10 business days of the letter's date (6 May 2026) so it can clarify liability.
data.explanation: The other driver involved in your accident has filed a claim, and this insurer needs your account of what happened to decide who is liable. Fill in the enclosed questionnaire describing the accident and send it back by the deadline shown. If you don't respond, the insurer may have to decide liability based only on the other side's account, which could work against you. If you're unsure how to describe the accident or think you weren't at fault, it can help to consult a lawyer or your own insurer before replying.
